phase: Accounting Spine / F2 Direct-Investment instrument-dissemination diagnostic
purpose: Determine whether repeated searching of standard BPM6/Eurostat/BNR/OECD direct-investment presentations is scientifically capable of supplying the missing Direct-Investment currency-and-deposits subinstrument required by the existing BPM6-to-ESA F2 bridge.

official_standard_evidence.source: BPM6 / External Debt Statistics standard-component presentation
official_standard_evidence.finding: Direct-investment debt instruments are not required in the IIP standard components to be presented broken down by type of instrument; debt securities may be compiled as a supplementary item.
official_standard_evidence.implication: Standard BPM6 IIP dissemination does not guarantee a separately published Direct-Investment currency-and-deposits item.

official_standard_evidence.source: BPM6 Update Direct Investment Task Team — Sectoral Breakdown of Direct Investment
official_standard_evidence.finding: Direct-investment debt instruments are not disaggregated by specific instrument in the standard classification and can include debt securities, currency and deposits, loans, insurance/pension items, trade credits and other accounts; debt securities are the separately requested supplementary item.
official_standard_evidence.implication: A broad Direct-Investment debt-instruments series cannot be substituted for F2.

official_standard_evidence.source: Balance of payments — International transactions (BPM6) metadata
official_standard_evidence.finding: Eurostat describes Direct Investment as equity/reinvested earnings/debt instruments, while currency and deposits are explicitly instrumented under Other Investment.
official_standard_evidence.implication: The standard Eurostat BOP/IIP presentation does not supply the missing Direct-Investment F2 subinstrument used by the RMD bridge.

official_standard_evidence.source: Benchmark Definition of Foreign Direct Investment, Fifth Edition
official_standard_evidence.finding: The definition of Direct-Investment debt instruments includes currency and deposits among several debt instrument types.
official_standard_evidence.implication: Currency and deposits may conceptually belong inside Direct-Investment debt, but an aggregate debt-instruments publication does not identify the F2 share.

official_standard_evidence.source: Monthly Bulletin / International investment position presentation
official_standard_evidence.finding: The Romanian public IIP presentation reports Direct Investment as equity plus debt instruments; currency and deposits are separately shown under Other Investment.
official_standard_evidence.implication: The reviewed standard Romanian public presentation does not provide the required Direct-Investment currency-and-deposits split.

adjudication.reason: The missing bridge item is a specific instrument nested inside the broader Direct-Investment debt category. Official standards do not require that category to be broken down by instrument in standard IIP/BOP dissemination, and the reviewed Eurostat/BNR presentations retain the broader debt aggregate. Repeating standard-dataset searches without a new country-specific supplementary source cannot satisfy the frozen F2 trigger.

still_valid_reopen_paths: A Romania-specific supplementary table/API/microdata publication explicitly separates currency and deposits inside Direct-Investment debt instruments for the required 2025 sector/unit boundary.
An equivalent official exact bridge identifies the Direct-Investment F2 contribution without residual allocation or historical shares.
